record.title: Prepare one read-only Sparrow identity liveness observation
record.intent: Distinguish responsive stock application networking from the completed negative ADB handshake result.
requirements: Preserve and independently review the completed V5 connection failure, including the full implementation wait, exact failure reply, peer TCP acknowledgement without ADB application response and proven owned server retirement before alias removal. Do not retry the handshake or infer a specimen daemon cause.

Prepare a separate one-shot read-only SCPI identity observation using only the existing documented endpoint and exact *IDN? newline request. Require current isolated lease authority, fresh full capture, verified host isolation and explicitly bound host source address. Preserve raw request, response, timestamps and complete capture. No ADB server, source command, settings mutation, option query, broad service probe or RF record belongs to this diagnostic.

Retain the raw capture and graceful recorder statistics through socket closure and verified known host restoration. No reconnect, retransmission at application level, second query or retry after uncertain framing. Independently review exact source and deterministic controls before execution. A historical camera image or absence of a current view is not a fresh UI witness.
acceptance: One independently reviewed diagnostic is prepared or held within existing read-only bench authorization.
